purpose: Exhaust the remaining exact full-game team-total ladder and score-additivity covers from the retained Patriots-Seahawks event without another request.

team_total_ladders.payoff_proof: For lower integer threshold L below higher threshold H on the same team and game, team Over L plus team Under H pays one outside the interval and two when the final team score is at least L and below H; cancellation pays one because both legs resolve 50-50.

two_team_additive_covers.package: Patriots Under A plus Seahawks Under B plus full-game Over G
two_team_additive_covers.complete_proof_condition: A+B-1 <= G <= A+B for integer scoring thresholds
two_team_additive_covers.why_lower_bound_is_required: If the game reaches G, G greater than A+B-2 makes it impossible for both teams to remain below their thresholds, so the game-over leg plus any remaining under leg pays at least one.
two_team_additive_covers.why_upper_bound_is_required: If the game stays below G, G no greater than A+B makes it impossible for both teams to reach their over thresholds, so at least one under leg pays one.

methodology_correction.error: An exploratory calculation initially enforced only G >= A+B-1 and therefore admitted states below G where both teams exceeded their thresholds and every package leg paid zero.
methodology_correction.durable_rule: Never accept an additive cover from one directional implication; enumerate both the event and complement states and require the complete bidirectional threshold condition before price access.
